newsitem.title: BOTSWANA: BOTSWANA STOCKS WEEK - BARCLAYS SHARES JUMP.
newsitem.headline: BOTSWANA STOCKS WEEK - BARCLAYS SHARES JUMP.

text.p: The Botswana Stock Exchange
domestic board increased by another 12.19 points last week to
close 2.25 percent up at 554.9.
Barclays stock rose 165 thebe -- 19 percent on its
July 11 close -- to jump the 10 pula barrier to 10.25. The
counter is now bid 1,025 thebe, sellers at 1,100 thebe.
Milling company and food wholesaler Sefalana Holdings
put on 20 thebe to 530 thebe; Botswana Insurance
added five thebe to 305.
Trading unchanged was brewery holding company Sechaba Trust
at 435 thebe with 1,228,500 shares changing hands.
among those untraded were oil company Engen
445/500 thebe, First National Bank bid up five thebe to
570 and security group Inco down five thebe to 95
thebe.
Food and tobacco wholesaler Metsef was at 680/700
thebe, clothing chain Pep Holdings was bid up 15 thebe
to 350, variable loan stock company RDC Properties was
bid 180 thebe with sellers at 200 thebe and Standard Chartered
Bank of Botswana was bid up 25 thebe to 825.
Investment company Kgolo ya Sechaba traded at 26
thebe its interim liquidation dividend of 165 thebe. It had
closed on July 11 at 190 thebe.
Domestic board turnover was 3,861,614 against the previous
608,582, with value also well up at 6,239,409 pula against
On the foreign board, car rental and fleet management group
Avis was the only counter to trade. The counter closed
13 thebe up at 669. Untraded were De Beers , 123 thebe
up at 13,319; professional services group Forbes, 49
thebe up at 796; McCarthy Retail group, shed 18 thebe
to 1,039; and Regent Undervalued Assets Fund was
unchanged at 4,000 thebe.
